title: Heliocentric Astrology (1910 Edition)
author: Holmes W. Merton
description: Heliocentric Astrology, or Essentials of Astronomy and Solar Mentality, with Tables of Ephemeris to 1913, by Holmes W. Merton under the pen name Yarmo Vedra, here in the 1910 edition. The book presents an astrology calculated from the Sun-centred positions of the planets, which Merton argues represent the real structure of the solar system and the solar origin of human mental and spiritual life. It covers fundamentals of astronomy, the heliocentric motions of the planets and their meanings, the twelve signs as types of character and aptitude, guidance on vocation, health and relationships, and instructions for using the ephemeris tables (to 1913) to construct heliocentric charts. It is the earlier edition of the work also held in its 1921 form, useful for comparing the development of the text.
